name: a-glossy-optimism-picnic
prompt: Camera pressed into the turf at the foot of a smooth rolling hill, tilted upward, so tall blades of vivid emerald grass frame the bottom of the tall portrait picture, the closest ones razor sharp and beaded with dew, the farthest melting into soft green blur. Halfway up the slope a young family sprawls on a red-and-white checked rug beside a wicker basket: a mum, a dad and a little girl in crisp white and pale pastel clothes, all three mid-laugh with heads tipped back, while their golden retriever hangs in the air above them in a joyful leap, ears flapping, paws tucked. Big oily-sheened soap bubbles float everywhere, a couple of them huge and right against the lens, their skins swirling with pink, turquoise and gold. Over everything a deep, almost unreal cobalt sky, darker at the top, dotted with a few neat puffy white clouds, and a blazing noon sun peeking into one top corner, its star-shaped glare spilling a slanting trail of pale hexagonal flare rings down across the bubbles. The feel of a glossy mid-2000s advertising stock photo promising a bright tomorrow: wide-angle, high clean daylight, saturated and polished, slight glow blooming off the whites, firm contrast, not a speck of dirt, colours kept to sky blue, lawn green, bright white and sunny yellow. The picture carries no words, signs or printed marks of any kind. Thanks.
